confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Home Assistant will be able to change this TV's overlay position, size, style, auto-hide, and auto-listen. It will not start the microphone, change the login, or install updates.

user.title: Pair your Kellie's Voice TV
user.description: On your TV, open Kellie's Voice → SETTINGS → Home Assistant → Manage TV layout from Home Assistant → Show this TV's pairing ID. Enter that TV PAIRING ID, not the separate Home Assistant device-registry ID. Manual pairing validates the ID's format but cannot contact or verify the TV. After upgrading both components, check the new 'TV alert receiver connected' diagnostic. It remains OFF and shows 'never' until that TV establishes a scoped alert connection. Turn on Home Assistant layout and TV notifications on the TV.

manual_confirm.title: Verify the TV pairing ID
manual_confirm.description: Manual pairing cannot verify that a TV is online. Compare the FULL ID below with the one currently shown by the actual TV under Kellie's Voice → SETTINGS → Home Assistant → Manage TV layout from Home Assistant → Show this TV's pairing ID: {pairing_id}. TV: {name}. To proceed, type the LAST FOUR hexadecimal characters from the ID ON YOUR TV into the field below. This can catch mistakes in the last four characters, but cannot check earlier characters or prove the TV is connected. Compare the ENTIRE ID carefully. If anything differs, go Back and correct the full ID.

pairing_preview.title: Verify a temporary Kellie's Voice TV pairing code
pairing_preview.description: On the test TV open Kellie's Voice Pairing Lab → Open LAN Two-Screen Code Preview → Start Discovery Preview. This verification exchanges temporary public keys only. It will NOT sign in, create an integration entry, or change your working TV login. Start the comparison?

pairing_code.title: Compare the eight digits on both screens
pairing_code.description: The temporary Home Assistant code is {code}. You should also see it in the prefilled 'Home Assistant verification code' field below. Compare every digit with the eight-digit code on the physical TV. If the code is absent on EITHER screen or differs, CANCEL. Only after an exact match, press Confirm with the physical TV remote and check the confirmation box. This is a public-key test only. No login, account or token is changed.

data.ha_code: Home Assistant verification code (must match the TV)
data.numbers_match: All eight digits match the TV; I pressed Confirm on the TV remote

owner_browser_consent.title: Owner-only browser authorization preview
owner_browser_consent.description: The TV's code and remote confirmation were verified. This optional QA step opens Home Assistant's own sign-in/authorization page, then discards the returned authorization code without requesting tokens or changing a TV login. Only the Home Assistant owner may continue. It expires quickly.

data.allow_browser_login: I am the Home Assistant owner and want to test the browser authorization screen

abort.no_id: The TV did not identify itself. Turn Home Assistant layout off and on in Kellie's Voice, then try again.
abort.use_discovery: If automatic detection is available, add the discovered TV. Otherwise use manual pairing.
abort.preview_verified: SUCCESS: Verified the TV's physical remote OK and cryptographic identity. No Home Assistant account, access token, TV configuration, or saved login was changed.
abort.preview_expired: The temporary 120-second TV discovery window expired. Start a new TV preview and try again.
abort.preview_cancelled: The temporary pairing preview was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
abort.invalid_pairing_preview: This untrusted TV pairing advertisement was rejected. No credentials were exchanged.
abort.preview_code_missing: Verification stopped safely: the Home Assistant comparison code was missing or changed. Do not approve an invisible or mismatched code. Restart the TV discovery preview and try again.
abort.owner_probe_expired: The verified pairing session expired. Restart discovery on the TV and compare a fresh code.
abort.owner_probe_cancelled: Browser authorization preview cancelled. No credential was created.
abort.owner_probe_owner_required: The initiating Home Assistant owner could not be verified for this discovery flow. Browser authorization was not started.
abort.owner_probe_unavailable: Could not safely start an owner-bound browser authorization preview. No login was changed.
abort.owner_probe_rejected: The owner/browser/TV pairing binding failed or was reused. Authorization preview stopped.
abort.owner_browser_probe_complete: Browser authorization callback verified and discarded. No token was exchanged, no TV was signed in, and no saved login changed.

error.invalid_device_id: Enter the pairing ID shown on your TV.
error.invalid_name: Enter a TV name up to 64 characters.
error.pairing_suffix_mismatch: The four characters don't match the entered TV pairing ID. Recheck the ID on the TV and correct it using Back.
error.preview_unavailable: Could not complete the public-key preview. Restart discovery on the TV and try again.
error.waiting_for_tv: The TV has not confirmed the matching code with its remote yet. Confirm there, then submit here again.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Show a short text announcement on one configured TV, or on every configured TV when no device id is given. This does not start the microphone.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the message stays up, from 4 to 45 seconds.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Ask a configured TV to open a Home Assistant camera entity. This does not start the microphone or send a stream URL.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: A camera entity, such as camera.front_door.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional snapshot heading. Set 'Show header' false to hide the title and caption.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the popup stays up, from 4 to 45 seconds.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_header.name: Show header
show_header.description: Default true. Set false for a headerless camera snapshot, including removal of the fixed caption.

image_fit.name: Image fit
image_fit.description: Crop fills the image area; Fit displays the entire frame with letterboxing.

refresh_seconds.name: Refresh (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: 0 disables automatic refresh (default). Use 2 to 30 seconds for in-place snapshots without popup flicker.

show_live_camera.name: Show live camera
show_live_camera.description: Show a temporary muted live HLS video overlay on a TV without interrupting audio or exposing camera URLs.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: An HA camera with live streaming support.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: Muted live stream popup for 4 to 180 seconds, default 90. A short popup may close before HLS video starts; try HA's Preload camera stream option to improve startup.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_header.name: Show header
show_header.description: Hide both the title and muted-live status line when false. Default shows them.

image_fit.name: Image fit
image_fit.description: Fit shows the complete stream/placeholder frame with letterboxing. Crop fills the image area (default).

refresh_seconds.name: Preview refresh (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: 0 disables preview updates (default); 2–30 refreshes the still image until the first real video frame appears or the popup closes.

hide_camera.name: Hide camera
hide_camera.description: Dismiss a currently visible Kellie's Voice camera snapshot or live stream on the selected TV. Does not dismiss announcements or start the microphone.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_forecast.name: Show forecast
show_forecast.description: Fetch today's daily forecast from a Home Assistant weather entity and show it on a configured TV. This does not run on a schedule and does not start the microphone.

entity_id.name: Weather entity
entity_id.description: A weather entity with a daily forecast, such as weather.forecast_home. Leave empty to use Forecast source on the device page.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the card stays up, from 8 to 45 seconds. The usual value is 20.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

init.title: Experimental native Assist timers
init.description: OFF by default. Enable only for this paired TV when its Home Assistant Assist pipeline supplies the TV's HA registry device ID and routes phrases to native intents. TV countdowns and Home Assistant keep separate clocks; verify on hardware before relying on timers. Existing manual timer actions remain available. This does not enable the microphone.

data.native_timer_intents: Enable experimental native timers for this TV
